[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant advised reviewing transactions at the end of the month to calculate total spending in each category and identify areas to cut back.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant recommended setting up automatic transfers to savings or investment accounts and reviewing the budget regularly.
